scope: Read-only F03 same-family unmarked candidate omission investigation. Only new runs/f03a-next-* artifacts are owned; no product or existing test changes.
prior_status: F02a and F18 accepted locally; source freeze released. Root concurrently investigates F11 read-only.

reviewed_execution_surface.resolver: Full source read. Stdlib-only imports, regex/constants at import time, CLI under __main__. Actual candidate/family_key/build/resolve_group/graph_projection functions will execute.
reviewed_execution_surface.io_replacements: Only load_inventory, load_decisions, sha256_file, atomic_json, datetime are replaced by in-memory adapters. Three MemoryPath arguments have non-filesystem resolve/exists/str. No candidate or selection code is patched for actual build observations.
reviewed_execution_surface.counterfactual: One separate direct resolve_group call supplies a manually constructed signal-free candidate to expose inclusion-only current-marker behavior. Explicitly labeled hypothetical input, never described as actual build output or product modification.
reviewed_execution_surface.supervisor: Fully read scripts/run_local_memory_hardening_tests.py. New exclusive f03a-next-baseline-001 log directory; one isolated Python worker, terminal unittest footer required, timeout/log limit enforced, own process-group cleanup only.
reviewed_execution_surface.worker: Preloads reviewed stdlib and resolver bytes, then denies open/directory enumeration/socket/subprocess/ctypes/process launch/filesystem mutation using Python audit hook; stat/lstat/readlink additionally patched. No source documents or model imports. Frozen clock prevents timezone reads. No OS sandbox certification.
reviewed_execution_surface.reader_and_ui: Read-only static policy/caller review only. No Reader execution, CLI decisions, HTTP/UI, CONFIG, SQLite, watcher or published generation operations.

expected_before: Marked plus unmarked same family: unmarked candidate is None, marked singleton is discarded, groups=0.
Adding same-family unmarked peer after a valid Human choice on a marked pair leaves old candidate_set_sha256 and Human resolution unchanged, despite changed inventory hash.
Adding a marked peer does invalidate that existing Human decision; changing a selected/other marked source also invalidates it.
Different extension, meaningful stem/parent, and all-unmarked families remain outside the marked group. Year-only directory removal and 2024年 residual parent differ.
Manually supplying an unmarked peer to current resolve_group still resolves unique current marker; inclusion alone is not sufficient for conservative F03a behavior.
interpretation: Passing the observation tests means current defects/residual boundaries were reproduced. It is not F03a acceptance, not a GREEN implementation run, and not V1.00 acceptance.
rollback: No product changes. Keep append-only evidence. Any later implementation requires new authorization, current before hashes, immutable RED tests and separate-context audit; at most two repair rounds. No reset, deletion, commit or push.
